review_method: Compared each candidate source-sense gloss (including raw gloss qualifiers) with the IE-CoR concept label; kept multiple compatible sense links; rejected a same-spelling candidate when its gloss named a different concept. This is a project-level sense crosswalk, not expert cognacy review. Five primary senses for flower were added from the generated crosswalk after checking each gloss directly against the flower meaning.

supplemental_review_sources.selection_rule: Exact local headword and a gloss that directly describes a flower; no ancestry claim was used in sense selection.
